typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Lead_ID as string,
		Customer_ID as string,
		Promotion_ID as string,
		Title as string,
		First_Name as string,
		Middle_Initial as string,
		Last_Name as string,
		Suffix as string,
		Gender as string,
		Birthdate as string,
		Address_1 as string,
		Address_2 as string,
		City as string,
		State as string,
		Zip as string,
		County as string,
		Phone as string,
		Do_Not_Call as string,
		Email_Address as string,
		Email_Opt_Out as string,
		Toll_Free_Number_Called as string,
		Time_of_Call as string,
		Date_of_Call as string,
		Call_Disposition as string,
		Plan_Effective_Date as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/ib_ind_kpaol_leads*']) ~> source1
source(output(
		RecordTypeId as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/ind_kpaol_leads_record_type_id.csv']) ~> RecordTypeId
Select1, RecordTypeId join(1 == 1,
	joinType:'left',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'right')~> Join1
ConditionalSplit1@cleanData derive(Gender__c = case(Gender=="M","Male",Gender=="F","Female",Gender),
		HasOptedOutOfEmail__c = coalesce(toString(toBoolean(Email_Opt_Out)), Email_Opt_Out),
		Do_Not_Call = coalesce(toString(toBoolean(Do_Not_Call)), 'false')) ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1 select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Lead_ID__c = Lead_ID,
		Customer_Agility_Id__c = Customer_ID,
		Promo_ID__c = Promotion_ID,
		Salutation__c = Title,
		First_Name__c = First_Name,
		Middle_Name__c = Middle_Initial,
		Last_Name__c = Last_Name,
		Suffix__c = Suffix,
		Gender__c,
		Birthdate__c = Birthdate,
		Other_Street_1__c = Address_1,
		Other_Street_2__c = Address_2,
		Other_City__c = City,
		Other_State__c = State,
		Other_Postal_Code__c = Zip,
		County__c = County,
		Home_Phone__c = Phone,
		Do_Not_Call__c = Do_Not_Call,
		Email__c = Email_Address,
		HasOptedOutOfEmail__c,
		Toll_Free_Number_Called__c = Toll_Free_Number_Called,
		Call_Time__c = Time_of_Call,
		Call_Date__c = Date_of_Call,
		Call_Disposition__c = Call_Disposition,
		Plan_Effective_Date__c = Plan_Effective_Date
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
source1 derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> AddADFId
AddADFId split(isNull(Promotion_ID)||isNull(Birthdate)||isNull(Phone),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(rejectNull, cleanData)
ConditionalSplit1@rejectNull derive(REJECT_REASON = concat('ADF:Required Field Contains NULL Value: ', iif(isNull({Promotion_ID}), 'Promotion_ID ', ''), iif(isNull(Birthdate), 'Birthdate ', ''), iif(isNull(Phone), 'Phone ', ''))) ~> errorLog
errorLog select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
Join1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_ind_kpaol_leads_Staging_Inbound_Campaign__c.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> Insert
Select2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_ind_kpaol_leads_source_reject.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> Reject
AddADFId sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_ind_kpaol_leads_raw.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> sink1
